slots.purpose: Hero: show the calm, organised side of online RSVPs for a destination wedding couple, matching the title promise of collecting every reply.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed or owned photo of a couple in their 30s at home or on a sunny terrace, relaxed and smiling, reviewing guest replies together on a laptop or phone. Screen angled away or softly out of focus so nothing on it is legible: no app, platform, logo or guest names visible. Soft natural daylight, uncluttered editorial styling (linen, coffee cups, perhaps a printed invitation on the table). Wide 3:2 hero with headroom for a title crop. Identifiable people need a signed model release recorded in the register.

consent.note: Model release for both people before use.

slots.purpose: Show how a QR code on a printed invitation or details card sends guests to the RSVP page (destination features section).
slots.shot_brief: Still life flat-lay, no people: a luxury printed invitation suite with a small RSVP details card carrying a QR code, on textured paper with a ribbon or wax seal and soft daylight shadows. Preferred: an owned or licensed photo. Fallback only if Nic approves: an AI illustrative still life (Higgsfield), no real venue, destination or couple depicted, the QR code a non-functional placeholder pattern that points nowhere, no platform branding, logos or legible names, captioned "Illustrative image". Not generated in this run because approval is not on file.
slots.caption: Illustrative image

slots.purpose: Show Wonderland Studio (our own planning app) as the place to collect RSVPs and build the seating chart, without pricing.
slots.shot_brief: Team-supplied screenshot of the Wonderland Studio RSVP or guest list screen, filled with sample names only (no real guest or couple data), Wedded Wonderland branding only, no third-party platform screens or logos, no prices. Desktop or phone frame, cropped to the RSVP status view. Only usable once the product team supplies it and confirms the data is sample data.

consent.note: Sample names only; confirm no real personal data on screen.

slots.purpose: Illustrate multi-event RSVPs for a destination wedding: guests answer for the welcome dinner as well as the ceremony.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed real photo of a destination wedding welcome dinner: long dressed table outdoors at dusk with candles, festoon lights and guests mid-conversation, at a named venue and town recorded in the register or by the photographer (location proven, not judged by appearance). Never AI. Guests seen from behind or softly blurred unless couple and guest consent is recorded; no identifiable children. Partner venue images from weddedwonderland.com package pages are possible candidates only once their supply agreement is confirmed to cover blog use.

consent.note: Couple consent and guest consent if anyone is identifiable.
